india_trends.title: Gold, silver rates today: Comex gold tumbles $47/oz; silver drops $1.5 amid firm dollar, inflation fears

The conflict in West Asia complicates potential peace talks, keeping oil prices high and impacting investor sentiment.

india_trends.title: GAIL Q4 results: PAT falls 15% QoQ to Rs 1,485 crore; co declares Rs 0.5 dividend
